metadata.description: A consolidated collection of Claude Code plugins for workflows across research, media, sysadmin, personal planning, dev tools, and more. Each plugin bundles primitives + a provisioning skill for domain-specific workspaces.

plugins.name: filesystem-organiser
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: filesystem organisation workflow — scan, dedupe, cleanup, rename, sort for local directories and Google Drive, with local/gdrive variants.

plugins.name: desktop-manager
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: Linux desktop management workflow — check system, install packages, apply config, troubleshoot hardware, review logs, update system.

plugins.name: budgeting
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: personal budgeting workflow — log transactions, categorize, forecast, track goals, monthly reports.

plugins.name: shopping
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: consumer shopping workflow — find product, compare vendors, check availability. Region-specific commands (e.g. Israel) now live in dedicated plugins like israel-skills.

plugins.name: ai-engineering
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: prompt engineering workflow — craft, eval, catalog, version, search prompts, with library/factory variants.

plugins.name: media-library
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: media library workflow — catalog, tag, search, sort, dedupe assets.

plugins.name: audio-production
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: audio production workflow — normalize, VAD, transcribe, diarize, podcast assembly, with engineering/podcast/transcript variants.

plugins.name: video-production
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: video production workflow — transcode, organise, dedupe, ComfyUI generation, cover art, with editing/generative/cover-art variants.

plugins.name: pr-media-work
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: PR and media monitoring workflow — scan coverage, summarize press, draft responses, comms strategy, with monitoring/response/strategy variants.

plugins.name: smart-home
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: smart home workflow — Home Assistant, Snapcast multi-room audio, Plex media server ops, with HA/audio/media-server variants.

plugins.name: debugging
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: debugging workflow — capture logs, isolate issue, diagnose error, track bugs, with code/system/issue variants.

plugins.name: content-writing
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: content writing workflow — draft, proofread, version, publish, style guides, with writing/blog/opinion/document variants.

plugins.name: career
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: career planning workflow — log roles, compare offers, track applications, salary benchmark, with planning/job-search/salary variants.

plugins.name: purchasing
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: purchasing workflow — intake, compare products, evaluate options, recommend, with general/tech-procurement/recommendations variants.

plugins.name: research-space
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: research workflow — source log, summarize, deep-dive, export, with deep-research/technical/osint/georeaction/stack/ecosystem/competitor variants.

plugins.name: legal-investigative
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: legal and investigative workflow — log evidence, analyze documents, redact, generate briefs, with legal-research/evidence/osint/document-analysis variants.

plugins.name: knowledge-documentation
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: knowledge documentation workflow — index, cross-link, build taxonomy, version docs, with wiki/resource-library/process-docs/experiment-report variants.

plugins.name: personal-planning
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: personal life planning workflow — log entries, review progress, set goals, with diary/health/family/house-search/preparedness/therapy/personal-dev/inbox variants.

plugins.name: ideation-planning
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: ideation and planning workflow — capture, evaluate, rank, simulate, with ideation/single-eval/multi-ranking/feature/decision/simulation/capture variants.

plugins.name: technical-docs
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: technical documentation workflow — READMEs, reference docs, changelogs, environment docs, with api-reference/code-docs/environment-docs/dev-notebook variants.

plugins.name: sysadmin-homelab
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: sysadmin and homelab workflow — diagnose, status, update config, backup, with linux/docker/conda/proxmox/nas/adb/sbc/remote-admin/lan variants.

plugins.name: dev-tools
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: dev tools workflow — scaffold repos, retrofit for agents, QA code review, templatize, session continuity, with 7 variants.

plugins.name: workspace-foundational
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: foundational workspace workflow — setup, context management, report parsing, inventory, template discovery, with 6 variants.

plugins.name: meta-tools
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: meta-tooling workflow — context management, MCP integration, feedback filing, primitive selection for Claude Code itself.

plugins.name: security-checkup
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: security and compliance workflow — vulnerability scanning, system hardening, config audits.

plugins.name: claude-user-memory
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: user memory and personalization workflow — recall, save, and inject persistent facts across sessions.

plugins.name: ai-attribution
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: AI transparency workflow — document human vs AI contributions, add attribution, audit provenance.

plugins.name: claude-transcription
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: audio transcription workflow — denoise, VAD, transcribe (Gemini/AssemblyAI/Whisper), clean, structure, export, with cloud and local engine backends.

plugins.name: hp5200-printer
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin: HP DeskJet 5200 printer and scanner operations — ink levels, color/B&W printing, scanning, auto-discovery.

plugins.name: repo-to-docs
plugins.description: Convert GitHub repos into polished documents (PDF, blog post, white paper, internal doc) via Typst, with optional AI banner generation and multi-target publishing.

plugins.name: israel-skills
plugins.description: Israel-specific Claude Code agent skills and commands — Hebrew term resolution, Israeli retail (Zap, KSP, Ivory, etc.), ILS currency, and regional utilities.
